sections.Profile:
"Alaska," released by Interflip S.A. in May 1978, is a four-player, solid-state pinball machine with an American places theme. The playfield features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, and two banks of five drop targets.

- Manufacturer: Interflip S. A.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
